provenance.go_hierarchy: is_a edges from go_term record metadata (no .obo parsing needed)

protocol.sentence2: UniProt Function section, FUNCTION: markers and {ECO:...} evidence tags stripped
protocol.protein_pool: reviewed proteins, cleaned function text >= 200 chars, >= 3 GO annotations resolvable to defined GO terms (alt_ids mapped to primary)
protocol.term_pool: GO terms with a definition and >= 1 is_a parent that is not a namespace root (biases sampling away from top-level terms); applied to positives and negatives alike
protocol.positives: 250 (protein, term) pairs sampled uniformly from actual annotations, <= 2 positives per protein
protocol.negatives: 250 terms sampled for the same proteins, excluding each protein's annotated terms and their full is_a ancestor closure (hierarchy-aware, avoids false negatives), namespace distribution matched to positives; <= 2 negatives per protein
protocol.constraints: no protein > 4 appearances total; no duplicate (protein, term) pairs
protocol.ancestor_closure: transitive closure over is_a edges only, memoised DFS, cycle-safe; term itself plus all is_a ancestors excluded when drawing negatives
